title: Rendley AI Video Agent output
description: Every run writes one dataset item. A run that starts the agent reports the job IDs to pick up later; a run that waits, or that picks a finished job up, adds the agent's message and the exported video's download URL. The video is also streamed into the run's key-value store as a durable file, because Rendley download URLs expire after a few hours.

results.title: Run results
results.description: One dataset item per run with the status, project, thread and job IDs, the agent's message, the exported video's signed URL and the key-value store copy URL.

video.title: Rendered video
video.description: Durable copy of the exported video (MP4, or WebM when the VP8 format is chosen), present once a run has picked up a finished export.
